planets.name: HAT-P-38 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Horna with a 4.64-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: HAT-P-38 b was found in 2012 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Horna. Its orbit and size follow Sato et al. 2012's fit, the archive's default.
